# miniz in Jam2

Upstream: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz
Version: 3.1.2
Commit: 77d0dce8627735138c51770d1799a1ef48f2117d
License: MIT; see LICENSE.

Compiled directly into the updater for ZIP reading and decompression only.
Archive writing, deflation and zlib-compatible APIs are disabled. No external
archiver is invoked. Upstream source is unchanged. The local miniz_export.h
provides the empty export macro normally generated by upstream CMake for a
static build. Recheck that header and compile definitions when updating miniz.
